title: 第23章 师弟师兄的爱情来了第24章 又一个师兄失恋了
content_zh:
“许师弟，你确定你不是骗我？”
“没有，绝对没有。”许君白真诚道：“宋师兄，你可要相信师弟我，师弟我可是你的好师弟，怎么会骗你，整个白云派谁不知道你我师兄弟的情义，师弟我就是坑其他人，也不会坑你。”
宋真罗师兄有些恍恍惚惚，莫名其妙被喊来，然后被许君白带来了白云集市，这个集市一般情况下，他是不会来的，来一次，灵石就没了。
白云集市，乃是白云派的特色，自发组织的小集市，你说它小吧，也不小，说它大吧，也不大。
这里什么都可以交易，功法，神通，还是各种各样的奇怪东西，都是一些师兄来这里摆摊，或者是交易的，手里不需要的东西，就拿出来交易。
正常来说，没什么好东西，都是一些比较特殊的东西。
此地也有不少商铺，其中，最为明显的莫过于是送仙坊，占据了集市的最好地方，也因为这座送仙坊的存在，形成了一个集市。
送仙坊内什么都有，也收很多东西，天材地宝啊，还是丹药等等，都收，只要有价值的东西，他们都要，只不过价格嘛，自然没那么高。
于是乎，一些人就摆摊，企图卖一个更高的价格。
也有一些假货，懂得都懂，总而言之，白云集市十分复杂，也十分考验自己的眼力，有人在这里买到过灵器，也有很多天材地宝，当然了，也有人亏本，买到了假货。
此地买卖，钱货易手，概不退换。
“许师弟，你直接说吧，到底有什么事情需要师兄帮忙的？”
宋真罗师兄认真道：“只要你给得起价格，师兄我呢，保证给你完成。”
手指搓动。
你懂得。
许君白递过去一块灵石，宋真罗师兄这才露出了一抹笑容。
“许师弟，你的事情就是师兄的事情，不要客气，有什么当面说，师兄我百分百给你搞定。”
“搞不定的话，你可以打我。”
退钱是不可能退钱的。
宁愿让你打一顿，我也不会退钱的。

这就是宋真罗师兄的做事方式。
“师兄说的哪里话，师弟怎么会打师兄呢，师兄出马，肯定没有问题。”
“事情是这样的，师弟我呢，最近又被安排了一个任务，任务要求呢，就是要师弟我找一块太阴鬼石回来，师弟我的实力你也知道，搬气一重天，实力弱小又卑微，根本不可能完成这个任务，师弟我这不是想到了师兄你。”
“我相信师兄你肯定会帮我的，对吧？”
宋真罗师兄身躯往前走了几步，回头：“师弟，别拉着我，我们不熟的。”
许君白拉着宋真罗师兄，他怂了。
“咳咳，师兄，师弟自然不会让你去鬼哭嚎坟的，师弟打听过了，那里面有一块太阴鬼石，所以……”
宋真罗师兄立刻转身，拉着许君白的手，亲切道：“师弟你可是我亲师弟，你的事情就是师兄的事情，放心吧，这件事情包在师兄身上，只是……”
搓手。
动作十分明显。
都放在你眼前。
能看不到吗？
许君白无语，这个师兄果真是不放过任何一个赚钱的机会。
真正的铁公鸡师兄，眼里只有钱，哪有什么师兄弟情义，不如灵石来得实际。
“师兄，以咱们的情谊，肯定少不了师兄的，只要师兄帮师弟拿到太阴鬼石，师弟我就算是砸锅卖铁也要报答师兄。”
“师弟言重了，不需要师弟砸锅卖铁，你要是实在没有灵石，飞魂蝶给我就行。”
“……”
师兄，你趁火打劫呢。
“师兄真爱说笑。”
“师弟，师兄可不是和你开玩笑的。”

许君白白了他一眼：“师兄，你就说帮不帮吧？”
宋真罗眯着眼：“师弟，按道理说你可以自己去买，没必要非要让我去。”
“你，很不对劲。”
content_en:
"Junior Brother Xu, are you sure you are not lying to me?"
"No, absolutely not." Xu Junbai said sincerely: "Senior brother Song, you have to believe me. Junior brother, I am your good junior brother. How could I lie to you? Who in the entire Baiyun sect does not know the friendship between you and my senior brother? Even if I cheat other people, I will not cheat you."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo was in a trance. He was called here inexplicably, and then Xu Junbai took him to Baiyun Market. Under normal circumstances, he would not come to this market. If he came once, the spiritual stone would be gone.
Baiyun Market is the characteristic of Baiyun Sect. It is a self-organized small market. You can call it small, but it is not small. You call it big, but it is not big.
Everything can be traded here, including martial arts, supernatural powers, and all kinds of strange things. Some senior brothers come here to set up stalls or trade. They take out the things they don't need and trade them.
Normally, there is nothing good, just some special things.
There are also many shops here, among which the most obvious one is the Immortal Sender's Square, which occupies the best part of the market. Because of the existence of this Immortal Sender's Square, a market is formed.
There is everything available in Xiangxianfang, and they also accept a lot of things, including natural treasures, earthly treasures, elixirs, etc. As long as they are valuable, they want them, but the price is naturally not that high.
As a result, some people set up stalls in an attempt to sell at a higher price.
There are also some fakes, everyone knows about it. All in all, Baiyun Market is very complicated and it tests your eyesight. Some people have bought spiritual weapons here, and there are many treasures. Of course, there are also people who have lost money and bought fakes.
When buying and selling here, money and goods change hands and cannot be returned or exchanged.
"Junior Brother Xu, just tell me directly. Is there anything you need Senior Brother's help with?"
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo said seriously: "As long as you can afford the price, Senior Brother, I will guarantee that it will be completed for you."
Fingers rubbed.
You understand.
Xu Junbai handed over a spiritual stone, and then Senior Brother Song Zhenluo showed a smile.
"Junior Brother Xu, your matter is Senior Brother's matter. Don't be polite. If you have anything to say to your face, Senior Brother, I will take care of it for you 100%."
"If you can't handle it, you can hit me."
It is impossible to refund money.
I would rather give you a beating than refund your money.
This is how Senior Brother Song Zhenra does things.
"What did Senior Brother say? Why would Junior Brother hit Senior Brother? If Senior Brother takes action, there will definitely be no problem."
"The thing is like this, junior brother, I have been assigned a task recently. The task requirement is to find a Taiyin ghost stone. Junior brother, you also know my strength. I can move a lot of energy, but my strength is weak and humble. It is impossible to complete this task. Junior brother, I am not thinking of you, senior brother."
"I believe that you will definitely help me, senior brother, right?"
Senior brother Song Zhenluo took a few steps forward and turned back: "Junior brother, don't hold me, we are not familiar with each other."
Xu Junbai pulled Senior Brother Song Zhenluo, and he was scared.
"Ahem, senior brother, of course junior brother will not let you go to the Ghostly Howling Tomb. Junior brother has inquired about it and found that there is a Taiyin ghost stone there, so..."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo immediately turned around, took Xu Junbai's hand, and said cordially: "Junior brother, you are my own junior brother, and your affairs are my senior brother's business. Don't worry, this matter will be taken care of by senior brother, but..."
Rub hands together.
The action is very obvious.
Put it all before your eyes.
Can't you see it?
Xu Junbai was speechless. This senior brother really did not miss any opportunity to make money.
The real Brother Iron Rooster only cares about money. There is no brotherhood. It is not as practical as Lingshi.
"Senior brother, with our friendship, senior brother is definitely indispensable. As long as senior brother helps junior brother get the Taiyin Ghost Stone, junior brother, I will repay senior brother even if I sell the iron."
"Junior brother, what you said is serious. There is no need for junior brother to throw away the pot and sell iron. If you are serious,If there is no spirit stone, just give it to me by Flying Soul Butterfly. "
"..."
Senior brother, you are taking advantage of the situation.
"Senior brother really loves to joke. "
"Junior brother, senior brother is not joking with you. "
Xu Jun rolled his eyes at him: "Senior brother, just tell me whether you want to help me or not? "
Song Zhenluo narrowed his eyes: "Junior brother, it stands to reason that you can buy it yourself, there is no need for me to go. "
"There's something wrong with you. "
